reasoning: The image shows tomato leaves with numerous small, dark brown spots with yellow halos scattered across the leaf surface, along with some larger necrotic areas near leaf margins. The small dark specks with chlorotic (yellow) halos are characteristic of Bacterial Speck of Tomato (Pseudomonas syringae pv. tomato). The pattern of small discrete lesions with yellowing fits this diagnosis better than Septoria (which has lighter centers with dark borders) or Early Blight (which shows concentric rings).
